Solara — (9.2) NEBULA

FORBIDDEN STAR

"Forbidden star, forbidden star"

[Verse 1]

Level twenty-four was right there

And at the boundary

Something was watching them

Not Scorpius — not Chaos — not anyone they had met before

Just watchers

And one of them said — very casually:

There is a star that should not be born

Under any circumstances

The whole fold

The whole galaxy

Will interfere if you try

(the crew said nothing)(for a moment)

[Pre-Chorus]

The Hunter said: I know this story

The Hero said: I also know this story

(they looked at each other)

The Hunter said: you do not know this story

The Hero said: I absolutely know this story

I know several versions

The Hunter said: you know zero versions

[Chorus]

Forbidden star, forbidden star

Something they won’t let be born

Forbidden star, forbidden star

What is it they’re afraid of?

Every fold, every galaxy lining up to say no —

Forbidden star, forbidden star

That’s exactly where we go

[Verse 2 — the theories]

The Hunter said: this is clearly about a star that was born before

And caused something catastrophic and they sealed it

The Hero said: NO — this is about a star that was NEVER born

But was supposed to be and something STOPPED it

And now the something that stopped it is afraid

The Hunter said: your version raises more questions

The Hero said: all good stories raise questions

(Castor looked at SOLARA)(SOLARA was looking at the door)

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Aldric had his notes

He said: I see it

(what do you see)

He said: the knowledge is there — it is all there

He said: the words are not forming

(he looked at his hands)

(the way someone looks when they cannot explain why they cannot say what they can clearly see)

He said: I am sorry — I do not understand why

(nobody said anything)(not even The Hero)

[Bridge]

The Hunter said: in the old stories a forbidden star means something that changes the hierarchy permanently

The Hero said: in the OLD old stories it means something that was promised before the hierarchy existed

The Hunter said: that is not a real category

The Hero said: everything is a real category if it happens

The Hunter said: (pause) that is actually a reasonable point

The Hero said: I know

The Hunter said: I still know this story better than you

(Castor put his hand on SOLARA’s arm)

She said: the watchers told us what is in there is important enough for the whole fold to stop

He said: yes

She said: then the whole fold already knows it is real

He said: yes

[Outro — SOLARA, spoken, production drops]

She said:

Let’s go through

Now

See what’s in twenty-four

Before they get here

(and she walked through)

(and the crew followed)

(The Hero still talking)(The Hunter still correcting)(Aldric still looking at his hands)

(The Swan dancing)(just slightly)(just a little)
